description:
Chop the bottom log of any tree and watch the whole thing fall down naturally!

Chop the bottom log of any tree and watch the whole thing fall down naturally!

- Works with all Mineclonia trees (oak, birch, spruce, jungle, acacia, dark oak, cherry)
- Leaves are left to decay naturally — no aggressive deletion
- Sneak to disable tree falling
- Custom sound support (place falling_trees_fall.ogg in sounds folder)
- Commands: /falling_trees_on  /falling_trees_off
